notes: Cadillac Australia sells a single BEV model, the Lyriq (right-hand-drive, imported/converted by GM Specialty Vehicles). Battery capacity (102kWh) and AC/DC charging figures (11.5kW AC / 190kW DC) are consistent across sources and treated as reliable. However, pricing and power-output figures show real conflict: launch-era press (2024/early 2025) cited approx. $117,000-$122,000 drive-away for the Luxury variant, while later 2025/2026 secondary sources (dealer/aggregator listings) show substantially lower drive-away figures in the $90,000-$95,000 range, consistent with reported price cuts and a shift to a single-trim MY27 lineup. Power output is also inconsistently reported: 272kW (single-motor RWD figure per some specs) vs 388kW (dual-motor AWD figure per others), and it is not clear from available sources which figure corresponds to the actual current-model-year AU-market variant. Because these conflicts could not be reconciled with confidence, priceAud and powerKw are set to null and flagged low-confidence rather than guessing which figure is current.

variants.priceBasis: Conflicting figures across sources: launch-era reports cite approx. $117,000-$122,000 drive-away; later secondary sources suggest $90,000-$95,000 drive-away following price adjustments. Could not be reconciled with confidence; set to null rather than guessed.
